title: Parsing with errors
description:
Parse a config line into a struct and report problems with your own error enum.

```
"width=800"  -> Ok(Setting { key: "width", value: 800 })
"width"      -> Err(MissingEquals)
"=800"       -> Err(EmptyKey)
"width=wide" -> Err(BadNumber("wide"))
```
requirements: `enum ParseError { MissingEquals, EmptyKey, BadNumber(String) }` with `#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]`.
`impl std::fmt::Display for ParseError` with friendly messages.
stretch: Parse many lines into a `HashMap`, collecting every error with its line number.
